snippet.title: the classroom 3 Walkthrough
snippet.description:
This is a walkthrough of the game "the classroom 3".

Play the game here: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/328786

You can visit my Patreon page if you want or something:
https://www.patreon.com/awalkthroughlife

Game created by luka (luksy, Luka Marcetic)
Audio by Terrence Fleming
___________
Game description (from creator):
Finally. I hope you enjoy the third and the last part which is a prequel to previous two games. There wouldn't be one without you guys. Thanks for the support. I love you all ;)

Since the game is intentionally hard at some parts to keep the same style of the previous games, I included a little help system which you'll see just when you'll most need it. But don't use it right away. Don't spoil the fun. Try hard and you'll do it sooner or later.
___________
#theclassroom #classroom #walkthrough #theclassroom3
